claims.pass_condition: Planning removes nothing, and application requires an exact, structurally valid, root-bound proposal plus explicit authority.
claims.counterevidence: Planning mutates storage, wrong approval applies, an undeclared sealed field is accepted, or the proposal applies to a copied cache root.
claims.observed_evidence: Dry-run, wrong-digest, exact-shape, copied-root, and exact-approval adversaries pass.

claims.pass_condition: Only an unchanged inactive live segment may be archived while its lease lifecycle lock is held.
claims.primary_surface: archiveCandidate plus active, busy, and post-plan reacquire fixtures
claims.counterevidence: An active lease becomes eligible, a held lifecycle lock is bypassed, or a newer session loses source history.
claims.observed_evidence: ACTIVE produces NO_CHANGES; held lock produces COORDINATION_BUSY; newer session produces STALE; all retain the hot segment.

claims.pass_condition: The complete original live JSONL byte segment is recoverable from a digest-bound cold blob before its hot source is removed.
claims.primary_surface: archive publication order, archive receipt, and full audit
claims.counterevidence: Only a summary is retained, compression changes bytes, or source is removed before blob, receipt, and anchor publication.
claims.observed_evidence: Two archived segments decompress to one valid eight-event chain with exact raw hashes and generations.

claims.pass_condition: Curation reduces routine hot records without changing the lease tail, generation, state, or key-set semantics.
claims.primary_surface: pre/post discovery comparison in shared self-test
claims.counterevidence: Discovery semantics change, active protection is invented, or routine discovery must decompress all history.
claims.observed_evidence: Stored hot records decrease while exact tail digest, generation, released state, and key-set digest remain equal.

claims.pass_condition: The only source-removal crash window is visible and the same exact proposal completes it idempotently.
claims.counterevidence: Discovery silently accepts duplicate archived source or retry creates a contradictory history.
claims.observed_evidence: Anchor plus exact source returns REVIEW_REQUIRED; exact reapplication returns RECOVERED and removes that source.

claims.pass_condition: A new process can continue both released and expired archived owner histories without raw hot history.
claims.counterevidence: Released generation restarts, expired keys disappear, or archived owners cannot append new events.
claims.observed_evidence: Released anchor continues at generations six through eight; expired anchor renews at generation three with its key and releases at four.

claims.pass_condition: Explicit bounded audit validates every cold byte and the complete receipt, predecessor-anchor, and event chains.
claims.primary_surface: auditArchives and missing, tamper, predecessor, and budget fixtures
claims.counterevidence: Missing or same-size-corrupt blobs pass, a resealed false predecessor passes, or the audit exceeds its ceiling.
claims.observed_evidence: Valid two-segment history passes; segment ceiling returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED; missing, same-size corruption, and false predecessor return REVIEW_REQUIRED.

claims.pass_condition: Derived receipts remain path-private and distinguish lightweight hot discovery from explicit full archive verification without an unsupported performance claim.
claims.primary_surface: serialized receipt assertions, contracts, and READMEs
claims.counterevidence: A machine path or raw run id leaks, cold integrity is claimed from hot discovery, or curation runs in the background.
claims.observed_evidence: Tamper audit output is path- and run-id-private; contracts refuse automatic curation and full-cold-integrity claims from hot discovery.

claims.pass_condition: CLI exposes separate plan, exact apply, and full audit commands while preserving the same authority boundaries.
claims.primary_surface: tools/game-production-runner self-test and discovery seam review
claims.counterevidence: CLI applies without explicit authority, hides deferred candidates, or lacks the full audit route.
claims.observed_evidence: 108 CLI checks and 47 discovery-seam checks pass, including candidate deferral, wrong approval, exact three-segment application, and thirteen-event audit.
